title: Which Ukrainian city away from the eastern and southern front lines will experience repeated Russian strikes on fuel stations by September 11, 2026?
background: Russian attacks have repeatedly hit fuel stations near Ukraine’s eastern and southern battle lines. The spread of this targeting pattern to cities farther from the fighting would broaden its impact on civilians.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official Ukrainian municipal statements and reliable contemporaneous reporting citing local authorities. 
  Resolution Conditions : Identify the Ukrainian city outside the eastern and southern frontline areas where Russian attacks are confirmed to have directly struck fuel stations on at least two separate days between September 1 and September 11, 2026. Reports of isolated attacks or incidental damage to nearby stations do not qualify. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the city.
